# hostinger_vps_virtual_machine_recreate (Action)

Recreates a VPS virtual machine with a new operating system template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terraform_data" "example" {
  input = "recreate-vps-virtual-machine"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [before_create]
      actions = [action.hostinger_vps_virtual_machine_recreate.example]
    }
  }
}

action "hostinger_vps_virtual_machine_recreate" "example" {
  config {
    virtual_machine_id     = 12345
    template_id            = 67890
    password               = "root-password"
    panel_password         = "panel-password"
    post_install_script_id = 24680
    wait_for_action        = true
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_id` (Number) The ID of the operating system template to install.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual machine to recreate.

### Optional

- `panel_password` (String) The panel password for panel-based operating system templates.
- `password` (String) The root password for the virtual machine. A random password is generated when omitted.
- `post_install_script_id` (Number) The ID of the post-install script to execute after recreation.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean) Whether to wait for the action to complete before returning. Defaults to true.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
